rowdata.pxWarningMessage: Writing application logic using the Java activity method impacts maintainability, discourages reusability, and increases risk during upgrades. Use this method only when necessary. If executing Java code is required, consider using the Call-Function activity method to execute a Function rule. Using Function rules encourages creating well-defined input and output parameters and can be reused across many different types of rules.
The use of activity rules should be limited. The need for activities can be reduced by using data transforms, as well as techniques such as case management, the Engine API, and declaratives.
